claude.summary: SME textile-chemicals maker posted a 55% jump in H1 revenue and a much higher profit off a tiny base, but margins are thin, working capital and debt are rising, and profit leans on an extraordinary item and a pending insurance claim.
positives: Half-year revenue up ~55% YoY to Rs 171 cr, a record and well above the prior trend of Rs 111-133 cr
PBT up ~2.6x YoY to Rs 3.9 cr; operating profit improving
Warrant conversion brought in equity, and preference shares were fully redeemed
negatives: Margins remain thin: PBT margin only ~2.3% and material costs rose sharply as a share of sales
Working capital ballooned, with receivables up Rs 19 cr and payables up Rs 25 cr; operating cash flow is only Rs 1.8 cr
Debt rising, with long-term borrowings up Rs 7 cr and finance cost of Rs 5.3 cr
quality_flags: The extraordinary item is shown as (67.87) lakh yet added to profit (Rs 2.77 cr to Rs 3.45 cr), which is inconsistent presentation
Profit is supported by an unsettled insurance loss-of-profit receivable of Rs 8.18 cr (emphasis of matter)
The low prior-year base was distorted by a prior-year tax charge of Rs 1.7 cr
The prior-year consolidated figures were not reviewed
